scope: Authored finite native strand and crossing structures, followed by selected local reads. Hidden-continuation candidates use exposed evidence and remain hypotheses. Display depth is a local ordered realization, not a measured three-dimensional reconstruction.

weave.title: Following four strands through an angular interlace
weave.scope: An authored common-reach construction and bounded observers. Shared words, direction substitutions, ordered sections and local crossing relations carry the construction. No photograph parser, learned generator, physical ribbon solver, automatic hidden-path completion or general knot classifier is claimed.
weave.localDepth: Each encounter owns a separate two-ended depth axis. The display reads its ordered endpoints as -1 and +1. Height, clearance and interpolation between encounters remain unspecified.
